verdict.rationale: Sift's Decisions API ingests the business's responses to users, such as approving an order, blocking for fraud, or cancelling due to chargeback. Sift also says it 'gets smarter the more data it has about your business,' and Review Queues and Workflows exist. Together these imply analyst decisions and fraud outcomes inform the model, but the evidence never explicitly says decisions retrain scores or update rules. Missing for 10: explicit documentation that review-queue decisions and confirmed fraud labels feed model training, any mechanism for outcomes to tune Workflow rules, and independent or hands-on corroboration of the learning loop.
